---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible build, packaging, or documentation failure.
title: ""
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Describe the failure and its impact.
Name the affected target and branch or release tag.

## Reproduction

List the commands, expected result, and actual result.
Include the relevant platform and tool versions.
Remove credentials, private paths, and sensitive output.

## Evidence

Link relevant files, issues, or pull requests.
Report passing, failed, and unrun checks separately.

## Acceptance

Describe the observable result that resolves the failure.
State any scope exclusions.
